No passado houve casos dessa poção causar o efeito contrário ao ser usada em guerreiros ainda conscientes em uma tentativa de curá-los. Por este motivo, seu uso tem controle rígido do Salão de Invocadores de Akras.
raw.th: ยารักษาที่ถูกแจกจ่ายโดยสภาซัมมอนเนอร์อาคราส ไม่เหมือนกับยาชุบชีวิตทั่วไป เพราะไม่เพียงฟื้นฟูความสามารถทั้งหมดของเพื่อนร่วมทีม แต่ยังฟื้นคืน HP จนเต็ม ในอดีตที่ผ่านมา มีบางคนได้รับบาดเจ็บจากการใช้ยา เพราะใช้ในขณะที่ยังมีสติอยู่ ด้วยเหตุผลจึงมีการจำกัดและควบคุมการใช้อย่างเคร่งครัด โดยสภาซัมมอนเนอร์
raw.vi: Thuốc độc do hội đồng triệu hồi Akras phân phối. Không giống như thuốc hồi sinh, nó không chỉ phục hồi khả năng chiến đấu của một đồng minh, mà còn nạp đủ HP. Trong quá khứ, đã có một số người bị thương khi uống thuốc vì khả năng chữa bệnh của nó trong khi họ vẫn còn ý thức. Vì lý do này, việc sử dụng lực của thuốc đang được hội đồng triệu hồi Akras kiểm soát chặt chẽ.

id: Peluru yang menempelkan pigmen bercahaya pada targetnya yang terbuat dari Mata Akut. Pemanggil bisa mendeteksi cahaya ini dari jauh, meskipun sering digunakan oleh Pembasmi Setan kalau mereka bekerja dalam satu tim. Para Pembasmi Setan juga diberikan pistol yang bisa digunakan untuk menembakkan peluru, meskipun pistol itu tidak punya daya jangkau maupun kekuatan yang kuat, jadi tidak bisa melukai targetnya.
name: MST_ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_70000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A bullet that applies a special glowing pigment made from an Acute Eye on its target. A Summoner is able to detect the glow even from a distance, thus it is often used among the Demon Slayers when they work in teams. The Demon Slayers are also given a basic gun to fire the bullet, but the gun does not have great range nor power, so it does not inflict any damage on its target.

Un invocador es capaz de detectar el brillo incluso desde la distancia, por lo que a menudo los Exterminadores de demonios la usan cuando trabajan en equipo. Los Exterminadores de demonios tienen un arma para poder disparar este tipo de bala. Sin embargo, este dispositivo no dispara muy lejos y no tiene mucho poder, por lo que resulta inofensivo para el objetivo.

raw.pt: Uma bala que aplica ao alvo um pigmento brilhante especial, feito com um Olho Agudo. Um invocador pode detectar o brilho mesmo à distância, portanto é usado por matadores de demônios quando eles trabalham em equipe. Os matadores de demônios também recebem uma arma básica para disparar a bala, mas a arma não tem muito alcance ou poder, então não causa nenhum dano ao alvo.
raw.th: กระสุนที่ใช้สีเรืองแสงพิเศษที่ทำจากสายตาแหลมคมบนเป้าหมายของมัน ซัมมอนเนอร์สามารถตรวจจับแสงได้แม้กระทั่งจากที่ห่างไกล ฉะนั้นมันจึงมักถูกใช้ในบรรดานักล่าปีศาจเมื่อพวกนั้นทำงานกันเป็นทีม นักล่าปีศาจยังได้รับปืนธรรมดาเพื่อยิงกระสุน แต่ปืนนั้นก็ไม่ได้มีพลังที่แรงหรือรัศมีที่ไกล ฉะนั้นมันจึงไม่สร้างความเสียหายใดๆ ให้กับเป้าหมาย
raw.vi: Một viên đạn được quét chất màu phát sáng đặc biệt được làm từ con Mắt tinh anh trên mục tiêu của nó. Người triệu hồi có thể phát hiện ánh sáng ngay cả từ khoảng cách xa, do đó nó thường được sử dụng giữa những Sát nhân diệt ma khi họ làm việc theo nhóm. Sát nhân diệt ma cũng được cung cấp một khẩu súng cơ bản để bắn viên đạn này, nhưng khẩu súng này không có tầm bắn xa cũng như sức mạnh, vì vậy nó không gây ra bất kỳ thiệt hại nào trên mục tiêu của nó.

id: Peluru yang menciptakan asap dengan menggunakan kemampuan Tetes Asap. Asap spesial ini tidak hanya menghalangi pandangan, tapi juga membuat daya penciuman maupun deteksi magis tidak bekerja. Sayangnya, ini juga mempengaruhi indra penggunanya juga, jadi tidak bisa digunakan untuk menyerang, dan hanya berguna untuk melarikan diri dari musuh yang kuat. Ketika menghadapi monster yang sangat kuat, kadang satu-satunya pilihan adalah mundur.
name: MST_ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_70100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A pellet that creates a smoke screen by taking advantage of properties of Smoky Drops. The special smoke not only obstructs one's field of sight, it makes it impossible to detect any scents or traces of magic as well. Unfortunately, as its effects affect the senses of its user as well, it can't be used in ambushes, and is only useful for escape from tough enemies. When faced with a formidable monster, sometimes retreating is the only option.

raw.es: Una munición que crea una cortina de humo gracias a las propiedades de las Gotas ahumadas. Este humo especial no solo obstruye la línea de visión, sino que también hace imposible detectar olores o rastros de magia. Desgraciadamente, como también afecta los sentidos del usuario, no puede usarse en emboscadas y solo es útil cuando se quiere escapar de los enemigos. Al enfrentarse contra un monstruo formidable, a veces la retirada es la única opción.

raw.pt: Uma bombinha que cria uma cortina de fumaça usando as características das gotas de fumaça. A fumaça especial não somente obstrui o campo de visão, também faz com que seja impossível detectar qualquer cheiro ou traço de magia. Infelizmente, seus efeitos afetam os sentidos do usuário também, então não pode ser usado em ciladas: só é útil para escapar de inimigos difíceis. Quando enfrentar um monstro formidável, às vezes recuar é a única opção.
raw.th: เม็ดที่จะสร้างม่านควันโดยการใช้ประโยชน์ของคุณสมบัติของหยดควัน ควันพิเศษไม่เพียงบดบังพื้นที่การมองเห็นหนึ่ง มันยังทำให้ไม่สามารถตรวจจับสัมผัสร่องรอยของเวทย์เช่นกัน โชคไม่ดีว่า มันก็มีผลกับสัมผัสของผู้ใช้เช่นเดียวกัน มันจึงไม่สามารถใช้สำหรับซุ่มโจมตีได้ และข้อดีเพียงอย่างเดียวก็คือเพื่อใช้หนีจากศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่ง เมื่อต้องเผชิญหน้ากับมอนสเตอร์ที่แข็งแกร่ง บางทีการหนีก็เป็นทางเลือกเดียว
raw.vi: Một viên bi tạo màn khói bằng cách tận dụng tính chất của Giọt khói. Loại khói đặc biệt này không chỉ cản trở tầm nhìn của một người, mà còn khiến cho người đó không thể phát hiện bất kỳ mùi hương hoặc dấu vết ma thuật nào. Không may, vì những hiệu ứng của nó ảnh hưởng đến cả những giác quan của người dùng nó, nên nó không thể sử dụng trong phục kích và chỉ hữu ích khi trốn thoát khỏi những kẻ thù khó đánh bại. Khi đối mặt với một con quái vật ghê gớm, đôi khi rút lui là lựa chọn duy nhất.

id: Katalis yang membuat Pemanggil bisa menggunakan sihir teleportasi. Tapi, tidak bisa digunakan untuk teleportasi secara bebas, hanya ke tempat yang telah ditandai dan sering digunakan oleh para Pembasmi Setan untuk pergi dengan cepat. name: MST_ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_70200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A catalyst that allows any Summoner to use teleportation magic. Although it isn't perfect, the process of creating this potion which produces highly refined magic is only disclosed to a few Summoners and its distribution to the public is strictly restricted.

raw.th: ตัวเร่งปฏิกิริยาที่ช่วยให้ซัมมอนเนอร์ใช้เวทย์เคลื่อนย้ายได้ อย่างไรก็ตาม มันไม่ได้ทำให้ผู้ใช้เคลื่อนย้ายได้ตามใจชอบ แต่ไปยังประตูที่ตั้งเอาไว้และมักจะใช้กันโดยนักล่าปีศาจเพื่อเป็นการเดินอย่างเร่งด่วน แม้ว่ามันจะไม่สมบูรณ์แบบขั้นตอนในการสร้างน้ำยานี้ซึ่งผลิตเวทย์บริสุทธิ์อย่างสูงเป็นที่รู้จักกันในหมู่ซัมมเนอร์ไม่กี่คน และการแจกจ่ายให้กับสาธารณะเป็นสิ่งต้องห้าม
raw.vi: Một chất xúc tác cho phép bất kỳ Người triệu hồi nào sử dụng phép thuật dịch chuyển tức thời. Tuy nhiên, nó không cho phép người dùng nó dịch chuyển tức thời tự do, chỉ hướng đến một cổng định sẵn và thường được sử dụng bởi các Sát thủ diệt ma như một phương tiện di chuyển nhanh. Mặc dù nó không hoàn hảo, nhưng lọ thuốc này sản sinh ra ma thuật được tinh chế cao và quy trình sản xuất ra nó chỉ được tiết lộ cho một vài Người triệu hồi và việc phân phối ra công chúng bị hạn chế nghiêm ngặt.

id: Ekstrak dari Kacang Mow, dicampur dengan Obat dan dikristalkan menjadi dupa. Dupa ini menstabilkan roh, menyembuhkan segala luka roh. name: MST_ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_70300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An extract from the Mow Nut, it was mixed with a Cure and crystallized into an incense. This incense stabilizes the spirit, and has the ability to cure any wounds that the soul itself may have suffered. It has the power to heal Demon Slayers for a short time, but it takes a lot of preparation to burn, and thus an exclusive burner is required. However, any error committed when processing this incense can result in dangerous ingredients, and thus it is not available for common use.

Tiene el poder de curar a los Exterminadores de demonios durante un breve período, pero se necesita mucha preparación para que arda, por lo que se requiere de un hornillo exclusivo para crearlo. Sin embargo, si se comete un error durante la preparación de este incienso, alguno de los ingredientes pueden resultar peligrosos, por lo que no todos tienen acceso a él.

raw.th: สารสกัดจากถั่วมาว มันถูกผสมกับยารักษาและตกผลึกเป็นกำยาน  กำยานนี้ช่วยให้จิตใจมั่นคงและมีพลังในการรักษาบาดแผลที่ถึงขั้นบาดเจ็บทางวิญญาณได้  มันมีพลังในการรักษานักล่าปีศาจในเวลาสั้นๆ แต่มันต้องใช้เวลาอย่างมากในการเตรียมที่จะเผามัน และด้วยเหตุนี้จึงจำเป็นต้องใช้ตัวเผาแบบพิเศษ อย่างไรก็ตาม หากมีความผิดพลาดเกิดขึ้นขณะดำเนินการใช้กำยานนี้ ผลที่ได้อาจอันตรายมากด้วยเหตุนี้จึงไม่มีไว้ให้คนทั่วไปใช้
raw.vi: Trích xuất từ Hạt gặt, nó được trộn với Thuốc chữa lành và kết tinh thành một loại hương trầm. Hương trầm này ổn định tinh thần và có khả năng chữa trị bất kỳ vết thương nào tâm hồn có thể phải chịu đựng. Nó có sức mạnh chữa lành cho các Sát thủ diệt ma trong thời gian ngắn, nhưng mất nhiều chuẩn bị để đốt và do đó cần có lư hương dành riêng. Tuy nhiên, bất kỳ lỗi nào phạm phải khi xử lý hương trầm này có thể dẫn đến các thành phần nguy hiểm, và do đó nó không có sẵn để dùng phổ biến.

raw.vi: Trích xuất từ Hạt gặt, nó được trộn với Thuốc tấn công, tinh chế và sau đó, kết tinh thành một loại hương trầm. id: Dibuat dengan Rumput Kering, cahaya dari mata ini diperbesar untuk menjangkau jarak yang sangat jauh, menjadikannya katalis sihir yang bisa dianggap ramalan. Cahaya tersebut punya tujuan khusus. Dapat menembus objek, meregang sesuai jarak, memantulkan roh kuat yang ditemuinya. Sejak barang ini dipakai, Pembunuh Setan mampu menemukan lokasi sarang setan lebih cepat.
name: MST_ITEMS_BATTLEITEMS_70600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Made by using Brown Grass, the light that this eye shines is amplified to cover a very long distance, making it a catalyst for magic that can very well be considered clairvoyance. The light that it shines has a particular purpose. It can penetrate any object, and stretch over any distance, reflecting off any strong spirits that it encounters. It is said that since this item came into use, Demon Slayers have been able to locate the dens of demons more quickly.

id:
The combined essences of all elemental Revenants, pulsing in a comforting, harmonious vibe, are concentrated within this palm-sized orb. Extremely rare and sought-after as a crafting material due to its wondrous properties.
The energy-rich debris of Orebus has infused abandoned Guardians with what Giselle believes are the deceased souls of Orebus inhabitants. As a result, the aptly named Revenants carry fragmented memories within their elemental bodies. Concentrating their essences into a single source results in a truly splendid sight.

For others, however, a mushroom is just a mushroom—that is, food.
